title: App-Outage Credit for Alcohol ID-Scan Violations — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
An app outage at the door is what stops an ID scan from completing. Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, a dispute of an alcohol-procedure violation therefore carries an outage credit.

**Which batch.** The disputed violation's batch is the batch named on the alcohol-procedure violation under dispute.

**Clause.** The outage credit counts the rating exclusions granted on the disputed violation's batch for the reason "app outage": 2 or more give an outage credit of 4 points; exactly one gives 3 points; none gives no credit.

| App-outage rating exclusions on the batch | Outage credit |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 4 points |
| Exactly 1 | 3 points |
| None | None |

Only exclusions already granted on the account for ratings on that batch, with the reason app outage, are counted; exclusions for out-of-stock items, customer unreachable or store delay do not count toward this credit.

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- One rating on the batch excluded for app outage: 3 points.
- Two ratings on the batch excluded for app outage: 4 points.
- One exclusion for store delay and none for app outage: no credit.
